violation_type.title: Additional Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free from Other Activities Not Directly Involving Teaching, Care and Supervision (26 TAC §747.1501(c)(6))
violation_type.short_title: Additional Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free from Other Activities Not Directly Involving Teaching, Care and Supervision
violation_type.typical_finding: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that the caregiver was washing dishes when the child climbed and fell from the coffee table resulting in injury.

finding_variants.text: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that the caregiver was washing dishes when the child climbed and fell from the coffee table resulting in injury.
A volunteer caregiver was observed using their personal cellphone  to watch videos, while left in charge of the group.

The standard was evaluated for an investigation and was found not to be in compliance.  Based on the interviews with staff, the provider did not supervise young children appropriately but instead handled administrative duties which allowed a child to touch another child inappropriately during naptime.
